# Rover Operations Control Centre

The **ROCC** runs the rover from the ground ([[sources/rocc-glossary]]).

## Planning

It runs the [[concepts/tactical-planning-cycle]] every sol and produces the
[[concepts/activity-plan|activity plan]] ([[sources/rocc-glossary]]).
